newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U says proposes Q4 27 cents dividend.
newsitem.headline: P&U says proposes Q4 27 cents dividend.

text.p: Swedish/U.S. drugs group Pharmacia & Upjohn on Monday said it was proposing a fourth quarter dividend of 27 cents a share.

"The record date for payment of dividends is January 7, 1997. For shares traded in the U.S. on the New York Stock Exchange, the stock will be listed ex-dividend January 3, 1997," Pharmacia & Upjohn said in a statement.

"In Sweden, for shares traded on the Stockholm stock exchange, the stock will be listed ex-dividend January 2, 1997, with the last day of trading the stock with entitlement to dividend being December 30, 1996," it said.
It said dividends would be payable to holders of common stock and depositary shares on February 3, 1997.
